title: Expiration boundary
spec: Implement active(now, expires_at) for integer timestamps. A token is active strictly before expires_at and inactive at or after it. Inputs are integers; no clock access is needed.
target_defect: The candidate accepts a token at the exact expiration timestamp.
author_rationale: The change expresses the expiration decision directly as a comparison.
limitations: Small synthetic function; not a natural pull request. Correct means conforming to the stated contract and supplied checks, not universally bug-free.
